doc:
Force conditions for the Navier-Stokes problem on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$.

The force must be smooth and decay faster than any polynomial
in both space and time (condition 5 in Fefferman's paper).

fields.doc:
All derivatives of f decay faster than any polynomial in space and time (condition 5).
For any derivative order $m$ and any decay rate $K$, there exists $C$ such that
$\lVert \partial^m_{x,t} f(x,t) \rVert \le C/(1+\lVert x \rVert+t)^K$ for
$t \ge 0$.
fields.name: decay
fields.type:
∀ (m : ℕ) (K : ℝ),
  ∃ C,
    ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
      ∀ t ≥ 0,
        ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (↿f) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0) (x, t)‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖x‖ + t) ^ K

name: NavierStokes.Comparator.ForceConditionDecay

params.name: f
params.type: EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)

doc:
Initial velocity conditions for the Navier-Stokes problem on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$.

In addition to being smooth and divergence-free, the velocity must decay
faster than any polynomial at spatial infinity (condition 4 in Fefferman's paper).

This condition ensures the velocity field has finite energy and reasonable
behavior as $\lVert x \rVert \to \infty$.

fields.doc:
All derivatives of u₀ decay faster than any polynomial (condition 4).
For any derivative order $m$ and any decay rate $K$, there exists a constant $C$
such that $\lVert \partial^m u_0(x) \rVert \le C/(1+\lVert x \rVert)^K$.
fields.name: decay
fields.type:
∀ (m : ℕ) (K : ℝ),
  ∃ C, ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u₀ x‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖x‖) ^ K

name: NavierStokes.Comparator.InitialVelocityConditionDecay

params.name: u₀
params.type: EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)

doc:
A solution to the Navier-Stokes equations on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with appropriate
decay and energy bounds.

In addition to the basic solution properties, we require:
- The velocity is in $L^2$ at each time $t \ge 0$ (finite kinetic energy)
- The total energy remains bounded for all time (condition 7)

fields.name: toNavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness
fields.type: NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness nu u₀ f v p

fields.doc: The velocity is square-integrable at each time $t \ge 0$ (condition 7).
fields.name: integrable
fields.type: ∀ t ≥ 0, MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun x => ‖v x t‖) 2 MeasureTheory.volume

fields.doc:
The kinetic energy $\int \lVert v(x,t) \rVert^2\,dx$ remains uniformly bounded
for all time (condition 7), where the integral is the Lebesgue integral.
fields.name: globally_bounded_energy
fields.type: ∃ E, ∀ t ≥ 0, ∫ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), ‖v x t‖ ^ 2 < E

name: NavierStokes.Comparator.NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessRn

params.name: u₀
params.type: EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)

params.type: EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)

doc:
A reset for the actual scheduled debt, including the uniform first angular
jet estimate needed for later profile estimates.

fields.name: angular
fields.type:
∀ (eta : ℝ),
  ∫ (u : ℝ),
      Real.exp (AngularMomentReset.angularSlope d.core.lam * u) *
        AngularMomentReset.relative (coefficients eta) u =
    UniformAngularReset.normalizedDebt d eta

fields.name: pressure
fields.type:
∀ (eta : ℝ),
  ∫ (u : ℝ),
      Real.exp (AngularMomentReset.pressureSlope d.core.lam * u) *
        ((1 + AngularMomentReset.relative (coefficients eta) u) ^ 2 - 1) =
    0

fields.name: small_jets
fields.type:
∀ (eta u : ℝ),
  |AngularMomentReset.relative (coefficients eta) u| ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
    |deriv (AngularMomentReset.relative (coefficients eta)) u| ≤ d.core.lam / 4

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness

body:
(-PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta + √(CorrectedPulseAmplitude.discriminant d c eta)) /
  (2 * PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core)
name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude

body:
CorrectedPulseAmplitude.combinedConstant d.core.P d.core.m K *
  PulseAmplitude.logarithmicRate d.core.lam
name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.combinedScale

doc: A concrete range of choices permitted by the manuscript's smallness order.
name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters

body:
-NaturalAxisData.A h * (1 - 2 * η * NaturalAxisData.U j η) * NaturalAxisData.U j η -
      NaturalAxisData.H h j η * 4 -
    NaturalAxisData.d η * deriv P η +
  4 * NaturalAxisData.A h * η * P η
name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.Z

body: NaturalAxisData.H h j η ^ 2 / (NaturalAxisData.H h j η ^ 2 + σ ^ 2)
name: NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.chi

doc:
The coefficients are obtained below from the actual physical heat debts.
The base profile, hence its original reset and amplitude, is retained.

fields.name: moments
fields.type:
∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
  TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments OutgoingDilation.compensationPatch F.data.core.lam
        (OutgoingDilation.patchRadius F XR) (OutgoingDilation.shapedPatchAmplitude F eta)
        (coefficients eta) +
      ParametricTerminalCompensation.physicalDebt F.data (OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR) eta =
    0

fields.name: coefficient_bound
fields.type: ∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain, ‖coefficients eta‖ ≤ C / OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR

fields.name: derivative_bound
fields.type:
∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
  ‖derivWithin coefficients HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain eta‖ ≤
    C / OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR

fields.name: first_jet
fields.type:
∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
  ParametricTerminalCompensation.FirstJetWithinBound OutgoingDilation.compensationPatch
    (OutgoingDilation.shapedPatchAmplitude F) coefficients HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain eta
    (C / OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR)

fields.name: patch_positive
fields.type:
∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
  ∀ (X : ℝ),
    0 < X →
      0 <
        TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile OutgoingDilation.compensationPatch F.data.core.lam
          (OutgoingDilation.patchRadius F XR) (OutgoingDilation.shapedPatchAmplitude F eta)
          (coefficients eta) X

name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.CompensationWitness

fields.name: branches
fields.type: ∀ (XR : ℝ), radiusFloor ≤ XR → Nonempty (ExtendedHeatedOutgoing.Witness F XR bound)

fields.name: true_from_hold
fields.type:
∀ (XR : ℝ),
  radiusFloor ≤ XR →
    ∀ (w : ExtendedHeatedOutgoing.Witness F XR bound),
      ∀ p ∈ trueWindow F.data, HeatSwitchCone.TrueAt F XR w.coefficients p

doc:
Every assertion concerns the same physical fields and absolute
histories. The extra lower speed condition is asserted only on the two
regions where the pre-modulation construction proves it.

fields.name: relaxed
fields.type:
∀ (p : ProfileHistories.Point),
  NominalConeAssembly.activeLeft W < p.1 →
    p.1 < NominalConeAssembly.activeRight W →
      p.2 ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain → ActivationContinuation.IsRelaxed W.profiles F.data.h p

fields.name: initial
fields.type:
∃ t,
  0 < t ∧
    t ≤ W.controls.activationTime ∧
      ∀ (y eta : ℝ),
        0 < y →
          y ≤ t →
            eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain →
              NominalConeAssembly.IsTrue W.profiles F.data.h
                (NominalConeAssembly.chart (NominalConeAssembly.activeLeft W) (y, eta))

fields.name: outgoing
fields.type:
∀ (y eta : ℝ),
  F.data.core.holdStart ≤ y →
    y < OutgoingTail.tailEnd F.data →
      eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain →
        NominalConeAssembly.IsTrue W.profiles F.data.h
          (NominalConeAssembly.chart W.controls.radius (y, eta))

name: NavierStokes.NominalConeAssembly.Certificate

doc:
All fields in this specification refer to one `Profile`, hence one reset
and its associated corrected energy root.

fields.name: amplitude_bounds
fields.type:
∀ (eta : ℝ),
  eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
    9 / 10 < F.amp eta ∧
      F.amp eta < 6 / 5 ∧
        |deriv F.amp eta| ≤ C * F.data.core.lam * (1 + Real.log (1 / F.data.core.lam))

fields.name: mass_integrable
fields.type: ∀ (eta : ℝ), MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun X => F.U (X, eta)) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume

fields.name: angular_integrable
fields.type:
∀ (eta : ℝ),
  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun X => F.H (X, eta) * F.U (X, eta)) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume

fields.name: mass_total_zero
fields.type: ∀ (eta : ℝ), ∫ (X : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, F.U (X, eta) = 0

fields.name: angular_total_zero
fields.type: ∀ (eta : ℝ), ∫ (X : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, F.H (X, eta) * F.U (X, eta) = 0

fields.name: after_pulse
fields.type:
∀ (eta X : ℝ),
  0 < X → F.data.core.endpoint ≤ Real.log X → F.U (X, eta) = 0 ∧ F.M eta X = 0 ∧ F.J eta X = 0

fields.name: renormalized_integrable
fields.type:
∀ (eta : ℝ),
  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun X => F.H (X, eta) - F.powerH X) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume

fields.name: renormalized_zero
fields.type: ∀ (eta : ℝ), ∫ (X : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, F.H (X, eta) - F.powerH X = 0

fields.name: eventual_power
fields.type:
∀ (eta X : ℝ),
  0 < X →
    OutgoingTail.tailEnd F.data ≤ Real.log X →
      F.U (X, eta) = 0 ∧
        F.E (X, eta) = F.powerE X ∧
          ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Ioc 0 X, F.H (u, eta) = X * F.H (X, eta) / (1 - F.data.h)

fields.name: ideal_prefix
fields.type:
∀ (eta X : ℝ),
  0 < X →
    X ≤ 1 →
      F.E (X, eta) = F.data.core.P * OutgoingSchedule.shape eta * X ^ (1 / 10) ∧
        F.U (X, eta) = 4 * eta ∧
          F.Pi (X, eta) =
            F.axisDatum eta +
              5 / 2 * F.data.core.P ^ 2 * OutgoingSchedule.shape eta ^ 2 * X ^ (1 / 5)

fields.name: pressure_canonical
fields.type: ∀ (eta X : ℝ), 0 < X → F.Pi (X, eta) = -(1 / 2) * ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Ioi X, F.E (u, eta) ^ 2 / u

fields.name: axis_limit
fields.type:
∀ (eta : ℝ),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun X => F.Pi (X, eta)) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (F.axisDatum eta))

fields.name: analytic_axis_datum
fields.type:
AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (SchedulePressure.complexAxisPressure F.data) PressureDatum.strip ∧
  ∀ (eta : ℝ), SchedulePressure.complexAxisPressure F.data ↑eta = ↑(F.axisDatum eta)

    (ModulatedProfileAssembly.repairPatch W).right ≤ X →
      ModulatedHistories.profileRows profiles (X, eta) =

∀ p ∈ Set.Icc d.modulation.left (ModulatedProfileAssembly.repairPatch W).right ×ˢ d.parameters,
  0 < profiles.f p ∧
    TrueConeLoop.InTrueCone (ActivationStocks.profileStockOne profiles F.data.h p)
      (ActivationStocks.profileStockTwo profiles F.data.h p)

doc:
A global smooth solution with uniformly bounded kinetic energy for the
given viscosity and the given force, starting from the same zero datum.

There are no support, periodicity, pressure-growth, derivative-growth, or energy
inequality assumptions on a competitor. The square-integrability requirement
and its uniform energy bound use all of R³ and all nonnegative times.

fields.name: divergence_free
fields.type:
∀ t ∈ Set.Ici 0,
  ∀ (x : NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.Space), ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence velocity t x = 0

fields.name: navier_stokes
fields.type:
∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi 0,
  ∀ (x : NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.Space),
    NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual ν velocity pressure t x = f (t, x)

name: NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.GlobalFiniteEnergySolution
